limitations: Only new local unpublished drafts are written. No publish action or theme/configuration changes.
Editor roundtrip is independent of installed theme behavior; no public rendering claim.
Plain paste negative control is Chromium-only, delivered through a ClipboardEvent with text/html, not a physical clipboard. Firefox synthetic paste did not roundtrip content and is not qualified.
CodeMirror document is read after reload to include offscreen lines. No editor state is injected for HTML-block input.
normalization: Compare full DOM tree with all element attributes and nonempty text nodes after HTML parsing; trim/collapse whitespace only. HTML block serialization normalizes insignificant whitespace, so raw byte identity is not claimed.
notes: Chromium plain paste strips all 17 enhancement attributes; this negative case passes by detecting the limitation.
Firefox synthetic clipboard negative attempts did not reopen the expected content and are unqualified. HTML block input uses actual keyboard insertion, independently passes all three engines.
No existing posts edited. Additional exploratory drafts remain local/unpublished. No plugin changes or theme/config changes made by this script.
